meta.name: prisma-client-api
meta.description: Prisma Client API reference covering model queries, filters, operators, and client methods. Use when writing database queries, using CRUD operations, filtering data, or configuring Prisma Client. Triggers on "prisma query", "findMany", "create", "update", "delete", "$transaction".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询和操作数据库记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要经常查询和修改数据库中的数据。
copy.tagline_en: Look up database query patterns with Prisma
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write database queries and update records.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在写 Prisma Client 数据库代码时会参照这份 API 参考,给出模型查询、CRUD、过滤、关系和事务的写法与示例。
howto.when: 当你写数据库查询、做 CRUD 操作或配置 Prisma Client 时接管;提到 “findMany”、“create”、“$transaction” 等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 用 prisma.user.findMany 查所有 ADMIN 用户
say.note: 会带上 orderBy、take 等选项写法

say.text: 把这次 create 和 update 放进 $transaction
给这条查询加 where 过滤和 select 字段
say.note: 返回过滤与字段选择的代码

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude consults this Prisma Client API reference when writing database code, giving model queries, CRUD, filters, relations and transactions with examples.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you write database queries, use CRUD operations or configure Prisma Client; also triggered by mentions like "findMany", "create", "$transaction".

say_en.text: Query all ADMIN users with prisma.user.findMany
Wrap this create and update in a $transaction
Add a where filter and select fields to this query
